identification: Three Cheyne Purdue pen and watercolour studies of Tasmanian colonial houses (white two-storey farmhouse with verandah; hipped-roof cottage among autumn trees; Georgian house with dormers and picket fence), each 18 x 25 cm on tan ground, matching timber frames with cream mats, each titled and signed in pencil below.
